Textiles: 60% interest, max Rs 60 lakh/yr. Vaccines: 70% (max Rs 60 lakh/yr) + 15% capital (max Rs 10 crore).

items.name: Cottage, handloom and handicraft assistance (Scheme E)

Handloom/handicraft artisans: 50% of machinery (max Rs 2 lakh) and 50% of working-capital loan (max Rs 2 lakh).
SC/ST/women/differently-abled: additional 10%.
items.extraFor: SC, ST, women and differently-abled: additional 10% subsidy

states.short: Goa Industrial Growth and Investment Promotion Policy 2022, with EDC schemes
states.statusText: In force. The EDC loan schemes and the cashew subsidy are confirmed from official pages; the 2017 umbrella schemes may have been replaced.

portal.label: Goa Online single window; EDC Ltd runs CMRY, MMIRS and GTEGP

states.zones: Pernem, Sattari, Bicholim, Sanguem, Quepem, Canacona and Dharbandora talukas get higher rates.
states.notes: Startups and IT units have separate policies.

items.name: Mukhyamantri Modified Interest Rebate Scheme (MMIRS) on EDC loans
items.summary: Rebate on EDC loans of 5% p.a. in backward talukas, plus 2% each for Goan, women and 20+ Goan staff.
details: Rebates stack: backward taluka 5%, Goan entrepreneur 2%, woman entrepreneur 2%, together capped at 7%. Units with 20 or more Goan employees get a further 2%. Total cap is 9% p.a. or ₹25 lakh per unit per year. Valid 1 Apr 2023 to 31 Mar 2028.
items.extraFor: Women entrepreneurs (at least 74% shareholding): extra 2% p.a.
conditions: Industrial or MSME loans from EDC Ltd only (new or existing); loan account must be standard
Negative list: alcohol, tobacco, construction complexes, transport, sponge iron and steel, mining equipment
Cannot be combined with other interest subsidies; CMRY and GTEGP loans excluded

items.name: Chief Minister's Rojgar Yojana (CMRY) 2023
items.summary: Soft finance up to ₹25 lakh at an effective 2% interest for Goan self-employment ventures.
details: Project up to ₹25 lakh (degree, diploma or ITI holders) or ₹20 lakh (others). 8% interest with a 6% rebate if EMIs are paid on time. Funding: 50% DITC share capital, 40% EDC loan, 10% own money. Extended to 31 Mar 2029.
items.extraFor: Women, OBC and divyang: own contribution 5% and EDC loan 45%. SC/ST: 80% DITC share capital, 15% loan, 5% own contribution. 5-year age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC, widows and persons with disabilities.
conditions: Resident of Goa for 15 years
All legal activities except alcohol and tobacco

items.name: Goa Tribal Employment Generation Programme (GTEGP)
items.summary: For Scheduled Tribe entrepreneurs: 40% subsidy on the loan and 2% interest, projects up to ₹25 lakh.
details: Project cap ₹25 lakh (micro or small manufacturing) or ₹15 lakh (services, trade). Subsidy of 40% of the loan amount (stated elsewhere as 38% of project cost). Interest 2% p.a., own contribution 5%, repayment over 60–120 EMIs.
items.extraFor: Only members of Scheduled Tribes notified by Goa.
conditions: Age 18–45 and unemployed
Resident of Goa for 15 years
No farming, tobacco or red-category industries
Scheme end date not stated

items.name: Employment Subsidy Scheme for Cashew Industry
items.summary: 50% of wages of Goan cashew-processing workers, max ₹7,000 per worker a month and ₹10 lakh a year.
details: Pays 50% of wages of eligible Goan employees, max ₹7,000 per employee per month for up to 8 months a year. Cap ₹10 lakh per enterprise per year, for 5 years. Notified 8 Sep 2022 (Gazette Series I No. 23), valid 5 years.
conditions: Cashew-processing MSME with Udyam, in the green or orange pollution category
At least 60% Goan employees on payroll
Workers paid at least minimum wage and employed 6 or more months in the claim year

items.name: Capital Subsidy Scheme (Goa State Incentives to Encourage Investments Scheme, 2017)
items.summary: 30% capital subsidy on plant, machinery, ICT and premises; max ₹10 lakh (micro) or ₹20 lakh (small).
details: 30% of plant and machinery, ICT equipment and premises; the building part is capped at ₹5 lakh (micro) or ₹10 lakh (small). Max ₹10 lakh (micro) or ₹20 lakh (small), paid once in two instalments. All umbrella-scheme benefits together are capped at 50% of investment (70% in backward talukas).
items.extraFor: The umbrella scheme allows up to 10% extra benefit for women and SC/ST entrepreneurs.
conditions: Production started after 1 Oct 2017, or an expansion of at least 25%
White, green or orange pollution category
Whether the scheme is still open in 2026 is unconfirmed

items.name: Interest Subsidy Scheme (2017 umbrella scheme)
items.summary: 30% of interest on term and working-capital loans, max ₹25 lakh a year for 28 quarters.
details: 30% of interest on term loans and working-capital loans (working capital limited to 1.5% of turnover). Cap ₹25 lakh a year, or ₹27.5 lakh for women and SC/ST. Paid for the first 28 quarters after production starts. Benefit scales with the share of Goan employees (60% minimum, full benefit at 80%).
items.extraFor: Women and SC/ST: cap ₹27.5 lakh a year.
conditions: Whether the scheme is still open in 2026 is unconfirmed
Cannot be combined with EDC's interest rebate or CMRY

items.name: Employment Subsidy Scheme (2017 umbrella scheme)
items.summary: 50% of salaries of Goan employees, max ₹7,000 per person a month and ₹25 lakh a year, 7 years.
details: MSMEs: 50% of salaries of eligible Goan employees (minimum salary ₹8,000 a month), max ₹7,000 per person per month and ₹25 lakh a year, for up to 7 years.
conditions: At least 60% Goan employees
Whether the scheme is still open in 2026 is unconfirmed

items.name: Certification and IPR Reimbursement Scheme (2017 umbrella scheme)
items.summary: 100% of non-statutory certification cost (max ₹8 lakh) and 50% of IPR registration cost (max ₹15 lakh).
details: 100% of non-statutory certification costs, excluding travel, lifetime max ₹8 lakh. 50% of IPR registration and professional fees, max ₹15 lakh.
conditions: Whether the scheme is still open in 2026 is unconfirmed

states.short: Viksit Gujarat Industrial Policy 2026: MSME scheme
states.statusText: In force for units starting production from 1 Jun 2026 (scheme GR of 25 Sep 2026). Units already in production stay under the Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for MSMEs 2022.

portal.label: Investor Facilitation Portal; GM-DIC sanctions micro and small units, the MSME Commissioner medium

source.label: MSME scheme GR, 25 Sep 2026 (copy published by ADAPT Associates)

states.zones: Talukas are Category A (130 less-developed talukas, higher rates) or Category B (138, including Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara and Rajkot cities and Sanand), per the GR of 8 Sep 2026.
states.notes: Units not yet producing can opt once for the 2022 scheme by 25 Mar 2027. A services MSME scheme is still awaited. State and central support together are capped at eligible fixed capital investment.

items.name: Capital subsidy (Component 1)
items.summary: 35% of eligible fixed capital investment in Category A talukas, 25% in Category B.
details: Micro: paid in year 1 (annual cap 37% A/27% B of EFCI, then 2% a year). Small/medium: paid over 5 years (annual cap 9% A/7% B). Thrust sectors (toys, sports goods, footwear, robots, drones): 35% A/30% B. Components 1-3 combined are capped at 45% A/35% B of EFCI (thrust sectors 50%/45%).
conditions: Manufacturing/job work only; services and trading excluded
Self-financed projects eligible; land, working capital and second-hand assets excluded
Assets bought from 2026-01-01; provisional certificate within 6 months of production, final within 6 months of completion; up to 2 years late with a pro-rata cut
Expansion needs +50% gross fixed capital investment (60% of it in plant and machinery) and +50% capacity; diversification needs +25% (micro/small) or +50% (medium)
85% Gujarat-domiciled workforce

items.name: Interest subsidy (Component 2)
items.summary: 7% interest subsidy on term loans for 5 years, up to 10% of EFCI (thrust sectors 20%).
details: Counts within the combined 45%/35% ceiling. The enterprise bears at least 2%; penal interest excluded. The GR scan is garbled at this number; 7% comes from ADAPT's reading of the GR and other summaries.
items.extraFor: +1% for women entrepreneurs, registered manufacturing startups and first-generation entrepreneurs
conditions: Disbursed term loans only

items.name: Power tariff support (Component 3)
items.summary: ₹2 per unit (Category A) or ₹1 per unit (Category B) for 5 years, up to 25% of EFCI.
details: Thrust sectors: same rates, capped at 20% of EFCI. Power from the DISCOM or open-access renewables only; captive generation excluded. Expansion units get it only on additional consumption. Counts within the combined ceiling.
conditions: Claims start after the provisional eligibility certificate

items.name: EPF reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of the employer's EPF contribution for new employees, for 5 years from production.
details: Cap per employee: 12% of basic+DA, or ₹1,800/month (men), ₹2,500 (women), ₹3,000 (specially-abled), whichever is lower. A new employee is one with no UAN before joining.
items.extraFor: Higher caps for women (₹2,500) and specially-abled (₹3,000) employees
conditions: New employees only

items.name: Electricity duty exemption
items.summary: Electricity duty exemption as applicable under the Gujarat Electricity Duty Act, 1958.
details: Secondary summaries call it 100%; the duration is not stated in the GR text read.

items.name: Quality, technology and IP support
items.summary: Quality certification 50% up to ₹10 lakh; patents 75% up to ₹25 lakh; technology acquisition 65% up to ₹50 lakh.
details: ERP 65% ≤₹1L; ICT/Industry 4.0 65% ≤₹5L; ZED 50% (after GoI aid) ≤₹50,000; energy/water audit 75% ≤₹50,000 each; recommended equipment 25% ≤₹20L (needs ≥10% savings).
conditions: Apply within 6 months of installation or certificate

items.name: Rent assistance
items.summary: 65% of rent for a rented or leased shed, up to ₹3 lakh a year for 5 years.
details: 75% if 100% women-owned, same ₹3 lakh/year cap. Runs 5 years from commercial production.
items.extraFor: 75% for 100% women-owned units
conditions: Apply within 6 months of the rent agreement
Coverage of medium units unconfirmed

items.name: CGTMSE fee, SME listing and power connection support
items.summary: CGTMSE fee 100% for 5 years; SME listing 25% up to ₹5 lakh; power connection 35% up to ₹5 lakh.
details: CGTMSE annual fee reimbursed on collateral-free loans (micro/small). Power connection charges covered for new or additional load outside GIDC estates.

items.name: Stamp duty reimbursement and extras (thrust sectors only)
items.summary: Thrust-sector MSMEs: 100% reimbursement of stamp duty and registration charges on project land.
details: Only toys, sports goods, footwear, robots and drones. Other thrust-sector extras: IPR 75% ≤₹1 Cr; international certification 100% ≤₹5 Cr; training ₹8,000/employee/month for 12 months; design studio 50% ≤₹5 Cr.
conditions: Apply within 6 months of production

items.name: SC/ST additional support (separate schemes)
items.summary: SC/ST extras are in separate Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar (SC) and Bhagwan Birsa Munda (ST) schemes, not this GR.
details: One secondary source cites an extra 5% ceiling for SC/ST entrepreneurs. The 2026 versions of these schemes were not located.
items.extraFor: SC/ST

Thrust sectors: auto, aerospace & defence, general engineering, electrical/electronics, pharma, rubber & plastic, footwear & leather, renewable energy, textile & apparel.
conditions: Manufacturing projects in the 9 thrust sectors only
New, expansion and diversification projects qualify
All state incentives for a project capped at 100% of FCI
Operational guidelines reported pending at launch

items.name: Interest subsidy for micro and small units

details: Core 5% (max ₹20 lakh a year); Intermediate 6% (₹20 lakh a year); Sub-Prime and Prime/Focus 7% (₹25 lakh a year). Duration unconfirmed.
conditions: Services eligibility and expansion eligibility unconfirmed

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement
items.summary: Net SGST reimbursement of 20–70% for 7 years, depending on area and share of in-state B2C sales.
details: If ≥50% of sales are B2C within Haryana: Core 30%, Intermediate 50%, Sub-Prime 60%, Prime/Focus 70%. Otherwise: 20%, 40%, 50%, 60%.
conditions: Sector limits and expansion eligibility unconfirmed

items.name: Stamp duty refund
items.summary: Stamp duty refund of 30–100% by area category.
details: Core 30%; Intermediate 60%; Sub-Prime 75%; Prime/Focus 100%.
conditions: Expansion eligibility unconfirmed

items.name: Employment generation assistance
items.summary: ₹1–1.2 lakh per employee per year for hiring Haryana youth (reported).
details: From launch coverage; eligibility, duration and caps unconfirmed.
conditions: Terms unconfirmed

items.name: Certification, testing and automation support
items.summary: Certifications 50% (max ₹10 lakh a year); international 60% (₹20 lakh); testing equipment 50% (₹25 lakh); automation 25%.
details: Standard certifications: 50% up to ₹10 lakh a year for 3 years. International certifications: 60% up to ₹20 lakh (2 years). Testing equipment: 50% up to ₹25 lakh, twice per policy. Automation/robotics: 25% (₹50 lakh–₹1 crore).

items.name: Market development, e-commerce and export support
items.summary: Trade fairs 25% (₹3–5 lakh); e-commerce fees 75% (₹1–2 lakh a year, 5 years); export incentives.
details: Export credit: 3% subvention up to ₹10 lakh a year for 3 years. New ZED-certified MSE exporters: freight aid of 1% of FOB (₹10/15/30 lakh a year by area). First-time exporters: 33% up to ₹20 lakh a year for 3 years.
conditions: Fairs up to 3 times a year

items.name: MSE insurance scheme
items.summary: Micro and small units: 33% of insurance premium reimbursed, up to ₹5 lakh a year for 3 years.
details: New MSE insurance scheme under the 2026 policy.

portal.label: HP Single Window (Emerging Himachal)

states.zones: Category A (developed), B (developing) or C (tribal areas and backward blocks and panchayats); benefits rise from A to C.
states.notes: Every incentive needs at least 80% Himachali employees. Trading is not covered; services qualify only if listed in Annexure II.

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement
items.summary: Net SGST reimbursed 60% (Cat A) or 90% (Cat B/C) for 7 years, capped at 100% of FCI.
details: MSMEs other than steel: 60% in A, 90% in B and C, for 7 years, capped at 100% of fixed capital investment. Steel manufacturers: 50% A, 80% B, 90% C.
conditions: New enterprise, or substantial expansion (plant and machinery value up at least 25%)
At least 80% bonafide Himachali employees
Commercial production within the extended deadline (currently 12 Oct 2026)
Negative list (Annexure-III) excluded; services only if on the Annexure-II list

items.name: Interest subvention on term loans
items.summary: 3% interest subvention on term loans for 3 years; max ₹2L, ₹4L or ₹6L per year (A/B/C).
details: 3% interest subvention on term loans for 3 years, capped at ₹2 lakh (A), ₹4 lakh (B) or ₹6 lakh (C) per year.
items.extraFor: Special-category owners (SC, ST, BPL, women, ex-servicemen, persons with disabilities, people affected by HIV/AIDS): 5% for 5 years, capped at ₹3L, ₹5L or ₹7L per year (A/B/C).
conditions: Same eligibility conditions as the SGST reimbursement

items.name: Stamp duty and registration fee concession
items.summary: Stamp duty and registration fee charged at 50% (A), 30% (B) or 10% (C) of normal rates.
details: Stamp duty and registration fee are charged at 50% (A), 30% (B) and 10% (C) of normal rates, meaning a 50%, 70% or 90% concession.
conditions: Same eligibility conditions as the SGST reimbursement

items.name: Concession on industrial land and sheds
items.summary: 50%, 60% or 70% concession (A/B/C) on the premium for government industrial land or sheds.
details: 50% (A), 60% (B) or 70% (C) off the fixed rate or premium for land or industrial sheds. MSME plots are paid 12% upfront plus 8 annual interest-free instalments. Production must start within 2 years of possession (1 year for sheds).
items.extraFor: Persons with disabilities get out-of-turn plot allotment.
conditions: Plots and sheds in Department of Industries industrial areas

items.name: Concessional electricity duty
items.summary: Electricity duty for 5 years of 1% (up to 50 kVA) or 3% (51–100 kVA).
details: Electricity duty for 5 years: 1% for small industrial consumers (up to 50 kVA), 3% for medium (51–100 kVA), 5% for large supply. Normal rates apply afterwards.
conditions: Same eligibility conditions as the SGST reimbursement

items.name: Concessional energy charges
items.summary: New enterprises pay energy charges 15% below the approved tariff for 3 years.
details: New enterprises: energy charges 15% below the approved tariff for 3 years. Substantial expansion: 15% rebate on the added consumption for 3 years. Given through the yearly tariff schedule and stated as not binding on the State.
conditions: Subject to the annual electricity tariff order

items.name: Transport subsidy (Category B and C areas)
items.summary: Transport costs reimbursed up to 3% (B) or 5% (C) of turnover, max ₹10 lakh a year.
details: Pays actual transport cost of raw material and finished goods within HP, or 3% of turnover (Cat B, 3 years) or 5% (Cat C, 5 years), whichever is lower. Max ₹10 lakh a year. Not available in Cat A.
conditions: Category B or C location only

items.name: Quality certification and patent support
items.summary: 50% of in-house testing setup cost for certification (max ₹5 lakh); patents: 75%, max ₹10 lakh.
details: 50% of the cost of in-house testing facilities for BIS, WHO-GMP, ISO or organic certification, max ₹5 lakh per enterprise. Patents: 75% of attorney and filing charges or ₹10 lakh, whichever is lower.
conditions: Same eligibility conditions as the SGST reimbursement

items.name: DPR and machinery transport reimbursement
items.summary: 50% of project report (DPR) cost, max ₹20K micro, ₹50K small, ₹1L medium; 50% of machinery transport.
details: DPR: 50% of consultant charges, max ₹20,000 (micro), ₹50,000 (small) or ₹1 lakh (medium). Inland transport and insurance of plant and machinery: 50%, max ₹2 lakh (A) or ₹3 lakh (B, C).
items.extraFor: Special-category owners, including women: 90% of DPR cost (same caps) and 100% of machinery transport up to ₹3 lakh.
conditions: Same eligibility conditions as the SGST reimbursement

items.name: Pollution control device subsidy

items.name: Green / environment-friendly technology subsidy

items.name: CGTMSE guarantee-fee reimbursement
items.summary: UT repays the 0.33% annual CGTMSE guarantee fee on loans up to ₹10 lakh.

items.name: Concessional industrial land premium
items.summary: Estate land at concessional premium: ₹5 lakh per kanal (Zone A) or ₹2.5 lakh (Zone B), small plots.

items.name: Net SGST reimbursement (existing units only)

details: Term loans from banks/financial institutions: reimbursement @4% (non-thrust, cap Rs 5 lakh/yr) or @5% (thrust, cap Rs 12 lakh/yr), 5 years. Whether this means interest-rate points or a share of interest paid is unconfirmed.
conditions: Term loans only

items.name: Employment Cost Subsidy
items.summary: Thrust-sector MSMEs with 20+ Tripura-domicile employees: 100% of employer EPF/ESI reimbursed for 5 years.
details: New thrust-sector MSMEs employing at least 20 State-domicile persons: 100% of employer EPF and ESI contribution for 5 years; 50% for years 6-10 if in continuous operation.
conditions: Thrust sector only
At least 20 employees domiciled in Tripura

items.name: Certification, technology transfer, ZED and CGTMSE fee reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of certification fees and technology-transfer cost; ZED bonus Rs 2-10 lakh; CGTMSE fees reimbursed.
details: Standard certifications (12 areas) and renewals: 100% of fees.
Technical know-how/technology transfer: one-time 100%.
ZED-certified Udyam MSMEs: Rs 2 lakh (P&M up to Rs 1 crore), Rs 5 lakh (Rs 1-10 crore), Rs 10 lakh (above Rs 10 crore).
Micro and small: 100% of CGTMSE guarantee and annual service fees.
conditions: ZED bonus needs Udyam registration and MoMSME ZED certificate
CGTMSE reimbursement for micro and small only

items.name: Procurement preference, trade fair and export subsidy
items.summary: 15% purchase preference and EMD exemption; trade fairs 50% (Rs 1 lakh/event); Bangladesh exports 10%.
details: State tenders: 15% price preference and 100% EMD/bid-security exemption for local manufacturers with at least 20% in-State value addition.
Trade fairs: 50% of travel (1 person) and goods transport, up to Rs 1 lakh/event, 2 per year.
Exports to Bangladesh via land customs stations: 10% of value, max Rs 50 lakh/yr.
conditions: At least 20% value addition in Tripura
Local service entrepreneurs (excluding works contract, IT/ITeS) eligible for the capital subsidy also get EMD exemption

items.name: State Transport Subsidy
items.summary: 50% of transport cost of secondary raw materials for local-resource-based and packaging units.
details: Local-resource-based industries and packaging-material manufacturers: 50% of cost of transporting secondary raw materials from outside Tripura, at railway standard parcel rates.
conditions: Only local-resource-based or packaging-material units

states.statusText: In force for five years from 28 Sep 2022, or until a new policy.

portal.label: Nivesh Mitra single window

states.zones: Bundelkhand and Purvanchal get the highest rates, Madhyanchal and Paschimanchal lower ones. Gautam Buddh Nagar and Ghaziabad get the lowest stamp-duty tier.
states.notes: Covers manufacturing and manufacturing-related services only; trading and general services get none of its incentives. There is no SGST or electricity-duty incentive. ODOP projects can get a separate margin-money grant.

items.name: Investment Promotion Assistance (capital subsidy)
items.summary: Capital subsidy of 10–25% on plant, machinery and building investment, by region and size; max ₹4 crore per unit.
details: Bundelkhand & Purvanchal: micro 25%, small 20%, medium 15%. Madhyanchal & Paschimanchal: 20%, 15%, 10%. The policy does not exclude Gautam Buddh Nagar/Ghaziabad (a secondary source applies 20/15/10).
Land excluded. Paid in two equal instalments: at building completion, then at ≥50% commercial production.
items.extraFor: SC/ST and women-owned units (≥51% ownership): +2 percentage points
conditions: Trading excluded; services qualify only if manufacturing-related (e.g. CETP, CFC)
Negative list: tobacco/gutkha/pan masala, alcohol/aerated drinks, firecrackers, plastic bags <40 micron
Expansion/diversification qualifies if gross block and capacity each rise ≥25%
Investment must be completed and production started within 2 yrs (micro), 3 yrs (small) or 4 yrs (medium) of application

items.name: Capital interest subsidy (micro enterprises)
items.summary: New micro units get 50% of loan interest reimbursed over 5 years, up to ₹25 lakh per unit.
details: Paid yearly after that year's interest is fully paid; ceiling of ₹25 lakh per unit across 5 years; land cost excluded.
items.extraFor: SC/ST and women-owned units: 60% of interest (same ₹25 lakh ceiling)
conditions: Micro enterprises only
Same trading, services and negative-list limits as the capital subsidy

items.name: Stamp duty exemption
items.summary: Stamp duty exemption of 100% in Purvanchal/Bundelkhand, 75% in Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal, 50% in Gautam Buddh Nagar/Ghaziabad.
details: Applies to MSMEs being set up (and qualifying expansions). MSME industrial-park developers get 100% in all regions.
items.extraFor: Women entrepreneurs: 100% exemption anywhere in UP
conditions: The 75% Madhyanchal/Paschimanchal rate excludes Gautam Buddh Nagar and Ghaziabad (50%)

items.name: EPF reimbursement
items.summary: 100% of the employer's EPF contribution reimbursed for 5 years from start of production.
details: Clause 5.4.1: the full employer EPF share for 5 years; the policy states no ceiling.
conditions: New units; expansions under clause 5.8.2 terms

items.name: Quality certification, testing lab and patent/GI assistance
items.summary: Certification and testing-lab costs reimbursed 75%/50%/25% (micro/small/medium), max ₹5 lakh; patents 75%, max ₹10 lakh.
details: Same shares for IT systems (max ₹2 lakh) and mandatory professional training (max ₹0.5 lakh).
Patent/GI documentation 75% (max ₹10 lakh) plus attorney fees of ₹50,000 national / ₹2 lakh international; ERP 75% (max ₹1 lakh); ICT 75% (max ₹5 lakh).
conditions: Open to existing and new MSMEs

items.name: CGTMSE guarantee fee and SME-exchange listing support
items.summary: The state pays the one-time CGTMSE guarantee fee on collateral-free bank loans up to ₹2 crore.
details: Also reimburses 20% of the cost of raising equity on a stock exchange (max ₹5 lakh), for any MSME size.
conditions: Loans must be covered by CGTMSE

items.name: Mukhyamantri Yuva Udyami Vikas Abhiyan (CM-YUVA), separate state scheme
items.summary: Youth aged 21–40: interest-free bank loans up to ₹5 lakh, plus a 10% capital subsidy (max ₹50,000).
details: The UP MSME portal lists phase 1 as loans up to ₹5 lakh with 100% interest subsidy for 4 years, and phase 2 as ₹10–20 lakh with 50% for 3 years.
Requires 8th pass, a skill certificate from a state scheme, and UP residence.
conditions: New enterprises only
Trading eligibility unconfirmed
Not part of MSME Policy 2022

states.statusText: In force. Figures come from press reports of the 2023 notification; confirm the rates with the DIC.

portal.label: Invest Uttarakhand single window

states.zones: Categories A and B are hill areas (higher rates); C and D are mostly plains.
states.notes: Covers manufacturing only; service businesses fall under the Service Sector Policy 2024.

items.name: Capital subsidy (MSME Policy 2023)
items.summary: Capital subsidy capped by category: micro ₹50 lakh (A) to ₹20 lakh (D); medium up to ₹4 crore.
details: Maximum subsidy. Micro (investment up to ₹1 cr): A ₹50L, B ₹40L, C ₹30L, D ₹20L. Small: A ₹1.6 cr, B ₹1.2 cr, C ₹80L, D ₹60L. Medium (₹10–50 cr): A ₹4 cr, B ₹3 cr, C ₹2 cr, D ₹1.5 cr. Percentage rates unconfirmed. Paid in 2 yearly instalments (up to ₹1 cr) or 5 instalments (₹1–50 cr).
items.extraFor: +5% for units owned by women, SC, ST or persons with disabilities. One report gives caps of ₹5L micro, ₹10L small, ₹15L medium; another gives ₹10/15/20L. +5–10% for priority and ultra-priority manufacturing.
conditions: Manufacturing only; the service sector is excluded from this policy
Whether expansion qualifies is unconfirmed (false used as the conservative value)
Subsidy percentages and the 'small' investment slab are unconfirmed

items.name: Stamp duty reimbursement
items.summary: Stamp duty reimbursed 100% in categories A and B, 75% in C, 50% in D for new units.
details: New MSME units get back stamp duty paid: 100% (A, B), 75% (C), 50% (D). Which documents are covered (land or building purchase or lease) is unconfirmed.
conditions: New manufacturing units
Rate set by the unit's location category

items.name: Interest subsidy on loans
items.summary: Interest subsidy exists and was raised from the 2015 policy; rates, caps and duration unconfirmed.
details: Rates, annual caps and duration by category are not confirmed; ask the DIC.
conditions: Terms unconfirmed

items.name: Mandi fee exemption for hill agro-processing units
items.summary: 50% mandi fee exemption for 5 years for agriculture-based processing units set up in hill areas.
details: 50% exemption from mandi (market) fee each year for 5 years for new agro-based processing units in hill areas.
conditions: Agro or food-processing activity
Unit in a hill area (which categories count is unconfirmed)

items.name: Quality certification, trademark and patent assistance
items.summary: Up to ₹1 lakh for national or international quality certification, quality marking, trademark or patent.
details: Up to ₹1 lakh for quality certificates, quality marking, trademarks and patents. Press also reports ZED medal rewards of ₹75,000 (Gold), ₹50,000 (Silver) and ₹25,000 (Bronze); unconfirmed.
conditions: Whether existing units qualify is unconfirmed

states.statusText: In effect from 1 Oct 2026 for new manufacturing units and approved expansions (approved 20 Jul 2026). The earlier Banglashree scheme closed on 31 Mar 2025.

portal.label: MSME and Textiles Department (single window: silpasathi.wb.gov.in)

states.zones: Rates vary across Zones A, B and C; the district list comes with the notification.
states.notes: Covers manufacturing only; services and trading are not covered. Figures come from launch reports because the gazette text is not yet available.

items.name: Interest subsidy on term loan
items.summary: 25% (Zone A) or 35% (Zones B, C) of annual term-loan interest for five years.
details: Zone A: 25% of annual interest liability; Zones B and C: 35%; for 5 years from first loan disbursement. Annual or total cap unconfirmed.
conditions: New unit starting commercial production on or after 2026-10-01
Udyam registration required
Units that started production on or before 2026-09-30 are ineligible

items.name: Electricity duty waiver
items.summary: Electricity duty waiver for five years: 50% in Zone A, 75% in Zones B and C.
details: Zone A: 50%; Zones B/C: 75%; five years from commercial production. Micro/small units wholly owned by women or SC/ST: 100% waiver for five years, max ₹10 lakh a year.
items.extraFor: Micro/small units wholly owned by women or SC/ST: 100% waiver, max ₹10 lakh/year
conditions: New units from 2026-10-01; also listed for approved expansion of existing MSMEs
Medium coverage inferred from 'MSMEs' wording - confirm

items.name: Quality certification reimbursement
items.summary: 50% of ISI/BIS/ISO/HACCP certification cost; cap ₹5 lakh micro/small, ₹10 lakh medium.
details: Reimbursement of 50% of certification costs (ISI, BIS, ISO, HACCP); ceiling ₹5 lakh for micro and small, ₹10 lakh for medium enterprises.
conditions: WBIS 2026 unit (production from 2026-10-01)
Eligibility of expansion units unconfirmed

items.name: Expansion support package (capital subsidy, stamp duty/registration fee reimbursement, power subsidy)
items.summary: Approved expansions of existing MSMEs get capital subsidy, stamp-duty/registration reimbursement, power subsidy and duty waiver.
details: Components reported only; rates, caps and zone differentials unconfirmed.
conditions: Existing Udyam-registered manufacturing MSME
Expansion must be approved under WBIS 2026

items.name: MSME cluster infrastructure support
items.summary: Cluster infrastructure subsidy up to ₹5 crore per eligible MSME cluster.
details: Cluster must have at least 5 MSMEs, ₹250 crore combined investment and 500+ workers; total subsidy capped at ₹5 crore per cluster.
conditions: Cluster-level application, not an individual-unit benefit
items.onlyText: For MSME clusters applying together, not a single unit
